actionCalls.description: Phase G2. Mirrors Process_Recurring_Commitment but targets the employer's parallel Recurring GC (rsv_EmployerRecurring_GC). Activates the employer schedule so CurrentGiftCmtScheduleId + NextTransaction fields populate. Runs after Create_Employer_Recurring_GCS. Connector routes to Assign_Employer_Recurring_GDD to persist the employer's default designation.
actionCalls.name: Process_Employer_Recurring_Commitment
actionCalls.label: Activate Employer Recurring Commitment

assignments.description: Subflow entry (both stages). Copies in_matchEmployerIdFromCaller into var_Match_EmployerAccountId so the createAndPair stage has the employer Id in the local scalar every downstream node reads. On resolveEmployer this Assign runs before Get_ACRs_Match — the input is blank and var_Match_EmployerAccountId stays blank until Decide_Employer_Source picks it up from the datatable / lookup path.
assignments.name: Assign_Entry
assignments.label: Init: var_Match_EmployerAccountId

assignments.description: createAndPair stage init. Rehydrates var_MatchAmount and var_MatchStatus from the caller-stashed inputs (Details_MatchAmount does not render on this stage; screen auto-vars numMatchAmount/pkMatchReceived would be blank). All downstream assigns read these two real subflow variables — never numMatchAmount / pkMatchReceived directly on this branch.
assignments.name: Assign_Init_CreateAndPair
assignments.label: Init: createAndPair scratch vars

assignments.description: G4: Employer-source router path (a): user selected a row from dtEmployers on Pick_MatchEmployer. dtEmployers' firstSelectedRow lands in rsv_SelectedEmployer; this Assign copies rsv_SelectedEmployer.Id into var_Match_EmployerAccountId, which every downstream match node reads.
assignments.name: Assign_EmployerId_FromTable
assignments.label: Employer Id ← Datatable

assignments.description: G4: Employer-source router path (b): user did NOT pick a row from dtEmployers, so the fallback flowruntime:lookup on Account.ParentId governs. Copies lkpMatchEmployer.recordId into var_Match_EmployerAccountId.
assignments.name: Assign_EmployerId_FromLookup
assignments.label: Employer Id ← Lookup

assignments.description: resolveEmployer stage return. Writes the four resolveEmployer outputs (matchAmount, matchStatus, matchEmployerId, matchEmployerName) plus out_didError=false. NO connector — subflow interview ends here and caller reads outputs. Caller stashes these into monolith-scope vars for the createAndPair call. var_MatchAmount/var_MatchStatus also written so any downstream read stays consistent (Decide_Match_Max_Exceeded ran before this Assign and read numMatchAmount directly — screen auto-var is populated on this stage since Details_MatchAmount rendered).
assignments.name: Assign_ResolveOutputs
assignments.label: Return: resolveEmployer outputs

assignments.description: createAndPair stage return. Sets out_matchApplied=true + out_matchGTId + out_didError=false. NO connector — subflow interview ends. Caller inspects out_didError, then routes to Decide_Match_Post_Route (which stays in monolith) to continue the terminal chain or Update path.
assignments.name: Assign_CreateAndPair_Outputs
assignments.label: Return: createAndPair outputs

assignments.description: Shape B fault sink — every critical fault path (4 lookup faults, 4 create faults, 1 update fault, 1 action fault) routes here. Sets out_didError=true + generic message + out_matchApplied=false. NO connector — subflow returns. Caller inspects out_didError and shows its monolith-owned Error screen (Error_CouldNotLoadData or Error_RecordNotSaved depending on stage).
assignments.name: Assign_DidError_True
assignments.label: Return: didError=true

value.stringValue: Employer Match subflow hit a fault (lookup, create, update, or action). See debug logs for the failing element.

assignments.description: Phase F2 (launcher plan §Matching-gift branch). Stages rsv_MatchEmployerGT ahead of Create_Employer_GT. DonorId = employer Account (var_Match_EmployerAccountId). OriginalAmount = var_MatchAmount (rehydrated from caller stash on createAndPair — Details_MatchAmount does not render on this stage so numMatchAmount would be blank). Status = var_MatchStatus (deliberately defaults to Pending per corporate-match cycle — see [[gt-status-default-paid]] for the exception; user radio flips to Paid if the match check already cleared). GiftType = Organizational (employer Account is always org / non-Person). TransactionDate + TransactionDueDate mirror in_donorGiftTransactionDate. FQS_Gift_Transaction_Category__c = 'Outright Gift' because the employer's payment is a fresh outright gift from their perspective. GiftCommitmentId is NOT assigned here — stamped downstream by Assign_Employer_GT_ParentToCommitment (PP branch) or Assign_Employer_GT_ParentToEmployerRecurringGC (Recurring branch); on Outright it stays null.
assignments.name: Assign_Employer_GT_Fields
assignments.label: Stage Employer Match GT

assignments.description: Phase F2 (launcher plan §Matching-gift branch). Stamps rsv_MatchEmployerGT.GiftCommitmentId = in_selectedCommitmentId on the Pledge Payment + match branch (both Fresh Insert and Update Existing populate in_selectedCommitmentId before invoking createAndPair).
assignments.name: Assign_Employer_GT_ParentToCommitment
assignments.label: Employer GT parent → Commitment

assignments.description: Phase G2. Stamps rsv_MatchEmployerGT.GiftCommitmentId = rsv_EmployerRecurring_GC.Id so the employer's first-payment GT parents to the newly created employer Recurring GC.
assignments.name: Assign_Employer_GT_ParentToEmployerRecurringGC
assignments.label: Employer GT parent → Employer Recurring GC

assignments.description: Phase G2 (launcher plan §Matching-gift branch, Recurring leaf). Stages the parallel Recurring GiftCommitment on the employer Account. Cadence mirrors donor GC (RecurrenceType=OpenEnded, FulfillmentType=Unconditional, FormalCommitmentType=Verbal, EffectiveStartDate=in_recurringStartDate, IsAssetTransferExpected=false). FQS_Match_Eligible__c is deliberately true — this IS the match commitment, so the eligible flag stays lit for future rollup/reporting parity with the donor GC. CampaignId inherited from in_selectedCampaignId. GC.ScheduleType intentionally NOT set on insert (platform-managed).
assignments.name: Assign_Employer_Recurring_GC
assignments.label: Defaults: Employer Recurring GC

assignments.description: Phase G2. Stages the open-ended GiftCommitmentSchedule row for the employer's parallel Recurring GC. Same cadence as donor schedule (TransactionPeriod=in_recurringPeriod, TransactionInterval=in_recurringInterval, StartDate=in_recurringStartDate, TransactionDay=in_recurringTransactionDay) but TransactionAmount=var_MatchAmount so expected match GTs fan out at the match value. PaymentMethod defaults to Check. Type=CreateTransactions engages the platform fan-out.
assignments.name: Assign_Employer_Recurring_GCS
assignments.label: Build Employer Recurring Schedule Row

assignments.description: Phase G2. Stages the GiftDefaultDesignation on the employer's Recurring GC. GiftDesignationId mirrors the donor's picked designation (in_selectedDesignationId) so employer expected GTs fan out to the same fund. AllocatedPercentage=100.
assignments.name: Assign_Employer_Recurring_GDD
assignments.label: Build Employer Default Designation

assignments.description: Phase F3a (launcher plan §Employer picker line 117). Stages rsv_MatchACR ahead of Create_MatchACR. AccountId = employer Account (var_Match_EmployerAccountId), ContactId = donor PersonContact (in_donorPersonContactId — safe because Decide_Match_Needed gates on IsPersonAccount=true in caller). Roles = 'Employee' (native ACR picklist).
assignments.name: Assign_ACR_Fields
assignments.label: Stage ACR Fields

assignments.description: Phase F2 (launcher plan §Matching-gift branch §Amount, line 124). Runs after Create_Employer_GT lands so rsv_MatchEmployerGT.Id is populated. Builds a SHELL rsv_UpdateDonorGT record with just Id + MatchingEmployerTransactionId + FQS_Match_Status__c — the subflow owns the DML (Update_Donor_With_Pair) to sidestep SObject-field-drop trap on cross-flow marshalling per [[flow-sobject-assign-drops-fields]]. rsv_UpdateDonorGT.Id = in_donorGiftTransactionId (caller passes scalar; subflow builds shell). MatchingEmployerTransactionId is the native GT-to-GT lookup pairing donor↔employer GT.
assignments.name: Assign_Pair_Onto_Donor_GT_Shell
assignments.label: Build Shell for Donor GT Update

assignments.description: Phase F3b (launcher plan §Matching-gift branch §Soft credits). Stages rsv_MatchSoftCredit_OnDonor ahead of Create_MatchSoftCredit_OnDonor. Recognizes the corporate Account on the donor's GT — GiftTransactionId = in_donorGiftTransactionId, RecipientId = employer Account (var_Match_EmployerAccountId), Role = 'Matched Donor'. PartialAmount = in_donorGiftAmount (donor GT's amount, not the match amount).
assignments.name: Assign_MatchSoftCredit_OnDonor
assignments.label: Stage Match SoftCredit (Donor GT)

assignments.description: Phase F3b. Stages rsv_MatchSoftCredit_OnEmployer ahead of Create_MatchSoftCredit_OnEmployer. Recognizes the donor Person Account on the employer's GT — GiftTransactionId = employer GT (rsv_MatchEmployerGT.Id), RecipientId = donor Account (in_donorAccountId), Role = 'Matched Donor', PartialAmount = var_MatchAmount.
assignments.name: Assign_MatchSoftCredit_OnEmployer
assignments.label: Stage Match SoftCredit (Employer GT)

choices.name: Choice_MatchReceived_No
choices.choiceText: No — the corporate match is expected but hasn't arrived yet

choices.name: Choice_MatchReceived_Yes
choices.choiceText: Yes — the corporate match has already been received

decisions.description: Subflow entry router. Reads in_stage and dispatches to the correct chain: "resolveEmployer" → Get_ACRs_Match (start of pre-donor-GT chain); "createAndPair" → Assign_Init_CreateAndPair (rehydrate scratch vars from caller stash before Assign_Employer_GT_Fields). Unknown stage falls through to Assign_DidError_True with a clear message.
decisions.name: Decide_Subflow_Stage
decisions.label: Route by in_stage

decisions.description: G4: Two-stage employer picker router. After Pick_MatchEmployer, chkUseEmployerLookup determines the source: checked (true) → user searched via the fallback flowruntime:lookup → Assign_EmployerId_FromLookup. Unchecked (false, default) → user picked a row from dtEmployers → Assign_EmployerId_FromTable copies rsv_SelectedEmployer.Id. Both Assigns write into var_Match_EmployerAccountId and connect to Get_Match_Employer.
decisions.name: Decide_Employer_Source
decisions.label: Router: Datatable vs Lookup

decisions.description: Phase F2.1. Gate after Details_MatchAmount collects numMatchAmount. If the employer's FQS_Match_Annual_Individual_Maximum__c is set and numMatchAmount exceeds it, show Warning_MatchMaxExceeded (informational — the match still posts as entered; heads-up not block). Otherwise skip to Assign_ResolveOutputs (return).
decisions.name: Decide_Match_Max_Exceeded
decisions.label: Match exceeds annual max?

decisions.description: Phase F2 (launcher plan §Matching-gift branch, lines 92-104). After Assign_Employer_GT_Fields stages the base employer GT, decide whether to parent it. Pledge Payment (fresh or update) → Assign_Employer_GT_ParentToCommitment reads in_selectedCommitmentId. Recurring → Assign_Employer_Recurring_GC spins up parallel employer Recurring GC. Everything else (Outright + match) → Create_Employer_GT with GiftCommitmentId null; only ACR + soft credits link the pair.
decisions.name: Decide_Employer_GT_Parent_To_Commitment
decisions.label: Employer GT parent to Commitment?

rules.name: Decide_Employer_GT_Parent_To_Commitment_IsPledgePayment
rules.label: Pledge Payment — parent to picked commitment

rules.name: Decide_Employer_GT_Parent_To_Commitment_IsRecurring
rules.label: Recurring — spin up parallel employer Recurring GC

decisions.description: Phase F3a. Post-Get_Existing_ACR gate. If a live AccountContactRelation between donor PersonContact and employer Account already exists → skip ahead to Assign_Pair_Onto_Donor_GT_Shell. If not (Get_Existing_ACR.Id blank) → route through Assign_ACR_Fields + Create_MatchACR to insert one.
decisions.name: Decide_ACR_Exists
decisions.label: ACR already exists?

Flow.description: Phase G7 — Employer Match subflow extraction. Owns two logical phases stitched under one in_stage discriminator: (1) "resolveEmployer" runs before donor GT is created — ACR/PRG/Account walk → Pick_MatchEmployer → Get_Match_Employer → Details_MatchAmount → Max-exceeded warning → return match employer + amount. (2) "createAndPair" runs after donor GT is created — Assign_Employer_GT_Fields → parent-to-commitment router → Create_Employer_GT → optional Recurring GC/GCS/GDD → ACR check/create → Update_Donor_With_Pair (shell record — subflow owns DML per [[flow-sobject-assign-drops-fields]]) → soft credits both sides → return matchApplied=true. Shape B error handling — every critical fault path (10 total) routes to Assign_DidError_True which returns out_didError=true; caller renders its own Error screen for UX consistency. GT.Status defaults to Pending intentionally per [[gt-status-default-paid]] employer-match exception (corporate matches typically clear 2 weeks to 3 months after the donor gift). Post-return routers Decide_Match_Post_Route and Decide_PostMatch_Campaign_Router stay in the monolith caller.

formulas.description: Phase G5 (mismatch-warning polish). Renders Get_Match_Employer.FQS_Match_Annual_Individual_Maximum__c as "$5,000.00" for the match-max warning body.
formulas.name: formulaDisplay_MatchAnnualMax

formulas.description: Phase G5. Renders numMatchAmount as "$250.00" for the match-max warning body.
formulas.name: formulaDisplay_NumMatchAmount

formulas.description: Phase G2. Auto-generated Name for the employer's parallel Recurring GC. Reads Get_Match_Employer.Name (loaded by Get_Match_Employer_ForRecurringName on the createAndPair Recurring branch) and var_MatchAmount (rehydrated from caller stash on createAndPair). Period word passed in from monolith formulaRecurringPeriodWord.
formulas.name: formulaEmployerRecurringCommitmentName

formulas.description: Phase F2.1: default value for numMatchAmount on Details_MatchAmount. If the selected employer has FQS_Match_Ratio__c populated, default = donor amount × ratio. Otherwise default = donor amount (1:1 assumption). Reads in_donorGiftAmount which caller sets from BLANKVALUE(SinglePayment_num_Amount, Recurring_num_Amount) — leaf-agnostic. User can still override on the screen. BLANKVALUE null-coalesces the ratio without throwing.
formulas.name: formulaMatchAmountDefault

formulas.description: Phase G5. Actionable delta line for the match-max warning — tells the user "That's $500.00 over the annual cap."
formulas.name: formulaMatchMaxDelta
formulas.expression: IF(OR(ISBLANK({!numMatchAmount}), ISBLANK({!Get_Match_Employer.FQS_Match_Annual_Individual_Maximum__c})), "", "That's $" & TEXT(ROUND({!numMatchAmount} - {!Get_Match_Employer.FQS_Match_Annual_Individual_Maximum__c}, 2)) & " over the annual cap.")

Flow.interviewLabel: FQS Gift Entry Subflow - Employer Match {!$Flow.CurrentDateTime}
Flow.label: FQS Gift Entry Subflow - Employer Match

recordCreates.description: Phase F2. Inserts the paired employer-match GiftTransaction via rsv_MatchEmployerGT. Reached from Decide_Employer_GT_Parent_To_Commitment default (Outright), IsPledgePayment (via ParentToCommitment), or IsRecurring (via ParentToEmployerRecurringGC). Fault → Shape B (Assign_DidError_True). Success → Get_Existing_ACR.
recordCreates.name: Create_Employer_GT
recordCreates.label: Create Employer Match GT

recordCreates.description: Phase G2. Inserts the employer's parallel Recurring GiftCommitment (rsv_EmployerRecurring_GC). Runs on Recurring + match=Yes ahead of the employer GT insert so the employer GT can parent to it. Do NOT stamp ScheduleType (platform-managed).
recordCreates.name: Create_Employer_Recurring_GC
recordCreates.label: Create Employer Recurring GiftCommitment

recordCreates.description: Phase G2. Inserts the employer's open-ended GiftCommitmentSchedule (rsv_EmployerRecurring_GCS). Connector routes to Process_Employer_Recurring_Commitment to activate the schedule immediately.
recordCreates.name: Create_Employer_Recurring_GCS
recordCreates.label: Create Employer Recurring GiftCommitmentSchedule

recordCreates.description: Phase G2. Inserts the employer's GiftDefaultDesignation (rsv_EmployerRecurring_GDD) so future employer expected GTs fan out to the same designation the donor picked. Runs after Process_Employer_Recurring_Commitment activates the schedule. Connector proceeds to Assign_Employer_GT_ParentToEmployerRecurringGC.
recordCreates.name: Create_Employer_Recurring_GDD
recordCreates.label: Create Employer Default Designation

recordCreates.description: Phase F3a. Inserts an AccountContactRelation between donor PersonContact and picked employer Account. Reached only from Decide_ACR_Exists when Get_Existing_ACR returns zero rows. Fault path routes to Assign_Pair_Onto_Donor_GT_Shell (best-effort — ACR insert failure is non-critical; the paired GTs are already in the DB and the pair still succeeds).
recordCreates.name: Create_MatchACR
recordCreates.label: Create Match ACR

recordCreates.description: Phase F3b. Inserts the corporate-Account recognition GiftSoftCredit on the donor's GT (Role = 'Matched Donor'). Fault path routes forward to Assign_MatchSoftCredit_OnEmployer (best-effort — both paired GTs are already in the DB).
recordCreates.name: Create_MatchSoftCredit_OnDonor
recordCreates.label: Create Match SoftCredit (Donor GT)

recordCreates.description: Phase F3b. Inserts the donor-Person-Account recognition GiftSoftCredit on the employer's GT. Fault path routes forward to Assign_CreateAndPair_Outputs (best-effort — the pair itself is already persisted). Success also routes to Assign_CreateAndPair_Outputs which returns clean.
recordCreates.name: Create_MatchSoftCredit_OnEmployer
recordCreates.label: Create Match SoftCredit (Employer GT)

recordLookups.description: G4: Loads AccountContactRelation rows for the donor Contact (in_donorPersonContactId). Feeds Transform_ACR_AccountIds. No IsActive / Roles filter — kept broad so donors with older or role-untagged relationships still surface.
recordLookups.name: Get_ACRs_Match
recordLookups.label: Get Donor ACRs

recordLookups.description: G4: Loads PartyRelationshipGroup rows where Type='Group' (employer / organizational groups; NOT Household) and AccountId is in Transform_ACR_AccountIds. Feeds Transform_PRG_AccountIds.
recordLookups.name: Get_EmployerPRGs_Match
recordLookups.label: Get Employer PRGs

recordLookups.description: G4: Loads Account records whose Ids are in Transform_PRG_AccountIds. Provides the datatable source for dtEmployers with the five match columns. Empty result is fine — the fallback flowruntime:lookup still lets the user pick manually.
recordLookups.name: Get_EmployerAccounts_Match
recordLookups.label: Get Employer Accounts

recordLookups.description: Phase F2.1. Loads FQS_Match_Ratio__c, FQS_Match_Annual_Individual_Maximum__c, FQS_Matching_Gift_Program__c, and Name off the employer Account picked on Pick_MatchEmployer. Consumed by formulaMatchAmountDefault, Decide_Match_Max_Exceeded, and (on resolveEmployer stage) Assign_ResolveOutputs.out_matchEmployerName.
recordLookups.name: Get_Match_Employer
recordLookups.label: Get Match Employer

recordLookups.description: Phase G7. createAndPair-Recurring-branch re-load of the employer Account so formulaEmployerRecurringCommitmentName can read Get_Match_Employer.Name. Separate node from Get_Match_Employer (which serves resolveEmployer) because Flow doesn't allow revisiting the same recordLookup twice in one interview from different branches, and createAndPair is a distinct interview. Filter mirrors Get_Match_Employer.
recordLookups.name: Get_Match_Employer_ForRecurringName
recordLookups.label: Get Match Employer (Recurring Name)

recordLookups.description: Phase F3a. Checks whether an AccountContactRelation already links the donor PersonContact (in_donorPersonContactId) to the picked employer Account. Reached from Create_Employer_GT. If found, Decide_ACR_Exists skips ahead to Assign_Pair_Onto_Donor_GT_Shell. If empty, routes into Assign_ACR_Fields + Create_MatchACR. Fault path routes to Assign_Pair_Onto_Donor_GT_Shell — an ACR-lookup failure shouldn't abort the pair.
recordLookups.name: Get_Existing_ACR
recordLookups.label: Get Existing ACR

recordUpdates.description: Phase F2. Persists MatchingEmployerTransactionId + FQS_Match_Status__c pair on the donor GT via shell rsv_UpdateDonorGT (Id + 2 fields only). Subflow owns the DML per [[flow-sobject-assign-drops-fields]] — caller passes in_donorGiftTransactionId (scalar), subflow builds the shell here.
recordUpdates.name: Update_Donor_With_Pair
recordUpdates.label: Update Donor GT with Employer Pair

screens.description: Phase G4 (two-stage employer picker). Datatable of the donor's ACR-linked employer Accounts + fallback flowruntime:lookup on Account.ParentId. Connector routes to Decide_Employer_Source which reads chkUseEmployerLookup.
screens.name: Pick_MatchEmployer
screens.label: Pick - Employer for Match

fields.name: PickMatchEmployer_Help
fields.fieldText:
Employer Match


Pick the employer that will match this gift from the table below (drawn from the donor's employer relationships and match-program details). If you don't see the right organization, mark the checkbox below to search for another Account instead.

fields.name: chkUseEmployerLookup
fields.fieldText: None of the employers below match this gift — search for another organization.

fields.name: PickMatchEmployer_FilterHelp
fields.fieldText: The table shows employers linked to this donor through their Account-Contact relationships. Household relationships are excluded automatically. When you mark the checkbox above, the search box falls back to any Account — admins can restrict it further by adding a lookup filter on Account.ParentId (for example, excluding household groupings). See the FQS README post-install steps.

screens.description: Phase F2.1. Screen 2 of 2 in the match-employer collect flow: confirm match amount. numMatchAmount defaults to formulaMatchAmountDefault. MatchAmount_ProgramMissingHint renders when the picked employer is NOT flagged as a match-program org. After Next → Decide_Match_Max_Exceeded gates whether the annual-max warning shows.
screens.name: Details_MatchAmount
screens.label: Details - Employer Match Amount

fields.name: MatchAmount_Help
fields.fieldText:
Confirm Match Amount


The default is calculated from the employer's configured match ratio. Adjust if this specific gift qualifies for a different match amount.

fields.name: MatchAmount_ProgramMissingHint
fields.fieldText: Note: this Account is not currently flagged as a match-program organization (Account.Matching Gift Program). Confirm with the donor or the organization before finalizing. If this is a legitimate match, consider flagging the Account so future gifts benefit.

fields.name: numMatchAmount
fields.helpText: Default = donor gift amount × the employer's Match Ratio (e.g., 1.0 = 1:1, 2.0 = 2:1). Falls back to the donor gift amount if no ratio is configured. Adjust manually if this gift qualifies for a different match.

fields.name: pkMatchReceived
fields.fieldText: Has the corporate match already been received?
fields.helpText: Written to the employer Gift Transaction's Status. No → Pending (the match is expected but hasn't cleared yet); Yes → Paid (the check has already cleared). You can update the Gift Transaction later when the match arrives. Employer-match GT deliberately defaults to Pending per corporate-match cycle (typically 2 weeks to 3 months after donor gift).

screens.description: Phase F2.1. Informational-only interstitial when the entered match amount exceeds the employer's FQS_Match_Annual_Individual_Maximum__c. Match still posts as-entered — heads-up, not a block. Single Next → Assign_ResolveOutputs → subflow returns.
screens.name: Warning_MatchMaxExceeded
screens.label: Warning - Match Exceeds Employer Annual Max

fields.name: Warning_MatchMaxExceeded_Header
fields.fieldText: Match amount exceeds employer's annual per-employee maximum

fields.name: Warning_MatchMaxExceeded_Body
fields.fieldText:
You entered {!formulaDisplay_NumMatchAmount}, but this employer's annual match maximum per employee is {!formulaDisplay_MatchAnnualMax}. {!formulaMatchMaxDelta}


The match will still post as-entered — this is a heads-up, not a block. If the donor has already received matches from this employer this year, coordinate with the employer before finalizing.


Click Next to continue, or Previous to adjust the amount.

transforms.description: G4: Extracts AccountId from AccountContactRelation rows returned by Get_ACRs_Match into a text collection. Downstream Get_EmployerPRGs_Match reads it as its AccountId IN filter.
transforms.name: Transform_ACR_AccountIds
transforms.label: Transform ACR AccountIds

transforms.description: G4: Extracts AccountId from PartyRelationshipGroup (Type='Group') rows returned by Get_EmployerPRGs_Match into a text collection. Downstream Get_EmployerAccounts_Match reads it as its Id IN filter.
transforms.name: Transform_PRG_AccountIds
transforms.label: Transform PRG AccountIds

variables.description: Discriminator input. Values: "resolveEmployer" (pre-donor-GT stage — ACR/PRG walk, picker, amount confirm, warning) or "createAndPair" (post-donor-GT stage — DML: employer GT, optional Recurring GC/GCS/GDD, ACR check, donor GT update, both soft credits).
variables.name: in_stage

variables.description: Donor Person Account Id (launcher recordId). Used by Assign_MatchSoftCredit_OnEmployer.RecipientId.
variables.name: in_donorAccountId

variables.description: Donor PersonContact Id (Get_Acct.PersonContactId in caller). Used by Get_ACRs_Match filter, Assign_ACR_Fields.ContactId, Get_Existing_ACR filter.
variables.name: in_donorPersonContactId

variables.description: Donor GT amount. Caller passes BLANKVALUE(SinglePayment_num_Amount, Recurring_num_Amount) — leaf-agnostic. Used by formulaMatchAmountDefault and Assign_MatchSoftCredit_OnDonor.PartialAmount.
variables.name: in_donorGiftAmount

variables.description: Populated only on Recurring branch (createAndPair stage). Passed to Assign_Employer_Recurring_GC.CampaignId so employer Recurring GC inherits the donor's campaign choice.
variables.name: in_selectedCampaignId

variables.description: Populated only on Recurring branch (createAndPair stage). Passed to Assign_Employer_Recurring_GDD.GiftDesignationId so employer Recurring GC's default designation mirrors the donor's pick.
variables.name: in_selectedDesignationId

variables.description: Donor GT Id (rsv_GiftTransaction.Id in caller). Used by Assign_MatchSoftCredit_OnDonor.GiftTransactionId + Assign_Pair_Onto_Donor_GT_Shell.Id (subflow builds shell record and owns the DML per [[flow-sobject-assign-drops-fields]]).
variables.name: in_donorGiftTransactionId

variables.description: Donor GT TransactionDate (rsv_GiftTransaction.TransactionDate in caller). Used by Assign_Employer_GT_Fields.TransactionDate + .TransactionDueDate — employer GT mirrors donor date.
variables.name: in_donorGiftTransactionDate

variables.description: Populated only on PledgePayment branch (Fresh + Update). Passed to Assign_Employer_GT_ParentToCommitment.GiftCommitmentId so the employer GT parents to the same commitment as the donor GT.
variables.name: in_selectedCommitmentId

variables.description: Monolith contextCommitmentId (launcher input scalar). Used by Decide_Employer_GT_Parent_To_Commitment_IsPledgePayment condition (OR branch: leafMonetary=PledgePayment OR contextCommitmentId not null).
variables.name: in_contextCommitmentId

variables.description: Monetary leaf choice value from Screen_Category (Intro_pk_LeafMonetary). Values: "Outright", "PledgePayment", "Recurring", etc. Used by Decide_Employer_GT_Parent_To_Commitment. NOTE: subflow compares against stringValue literals not choice references (choice records don't cross flow boundaries).
variables.name: in_leafMonetary

variables.description: Populated only on Recurring branch. Recurring_dt_Start in caller. Used by Assign_Employer_Recurring_GC.EffectiveStartDate + Assign_Employer_Recurring_GCS.StartDate.
variables.name: in_recurringStartDate

variables.description: Populated only on Recurring branch. Recurring_num_Interval in caller. Used by Assign_Employer_Recurring_GCS.TransactionInterval.
variables.name: in_recurringInterval

variables.description: Populated only on Recurring branch. Recurring_pk_Period in caller. Used by Assign_Employer_Recurring_GCS.TransactionPeriod.
variables.name: in_recurringPeriod

variables.description: Populated only on Recurring branch. formulaRecurringTransactionDay in caller (string per [[fundfirst-custom-schedule-shape]] — values "1".."31" or "LastDay"). Used by Assign_Employer_Recurring_GCS.TransactionDay.
variables.name: in_recurringTransactionDay

variables.description: Populated only on Recurring branch. formulaRecurringPeriodWord in caller (e.g., "Monthly", "Weekly"). Used by formulaEmployerRecurringCommitmentName to build the employer GC Name.
variables.name: in_recurringPeriodWord

variables.description: Stash-forward input. Populated only on createAndPair stage — caller reads out_matchAmount from prior resolveEmployer call and passes back on the second invocation. Assign_Init_CreateAndPair copies to var_MatchAmount.
variables.name: in_matchAmountFromCaller

variables.description: Stash-forward input. Populated only on createAndPair stage. Values: "Pending" / "Paid". Assign_Init_CreateAndPair copies to var_MatchStatus which writes rsv_MatchEmployerGT.Status.
variables.name: in_matchStatusFromCaller

variables.description: Stash-forward input. Populated only on createAndPair stage. Caller reads out_matchEmployerId from prior resolveEmployer call and passes back. Assign_Entry copies to var_Match_EmployerAccountId.
variables.name: in_matchEmployerIdFromCaller

variables.description: Shape B fault flag. Set true by Assign_DidError_True on any critical fault path; false by Assign_ResolveOutputs / Assign_CreateAndPair_Outputs on clean returns. Caller inspects and routes to monolith Error screen if true.
variables.name: out_didError

variables.description: Shape B fault message. Generic descriptor set by Assign_DidError_True.
variables.name: out_errorMessage

variables.description: createAndPair success flag. Set true by Assign_CreateAndPair_Outputs. Caller uses this to gate Success_succ_Match visibility on Screen_Success (replaces prior SinglePayment_pk_NeedsMatch=Yes visibility gate).
variables.name: out_matchApplied

variables.description: Confirmed match amount. Populated by Assign_ResolveOutputs (resolveEmployer stage) — caller stashes into var_MatchAmount and re-passes on createAndPair.
variables.name: out_matchAmount

variables.description: Match GT status choice. Values: "Pending" / "Paid". Populated by Assign_ResolveOutputs (resolveEmployer stage). See [[gt-status-default-paid]] employer-match exception.
variables.name: out_matchStatus

variables.description: Confirmed employer Account Id. Populated by Assign_ResolveOutputs — caller stashes and re-passes as in_matchEmployerIdFromCaller on createAndPair.
variables.name: out_matchEmployerId

variables.description: Employer Account Name. Populated by Assign_ResolveOutputs from Get_Match_Employer.Name. Caller writes to var_MatchEmployerName which drives Screen_Success.Success_succ_Match (replaces prior {!Get_Match_Employer.Name} merge-field read).
variables.name: out_matchEmployerName

variables.description: Employer GT Id after Create_Employer_GT lands. Populated by Assign_CreateAndPair_Outputs. Plan-ready for downstream linking (not currently read by caller).
variables.name: out_matchGTId

variables.description: Subflow-local scratch: unified employer AccountId. Written by Assign_Entry (from in_matchEmployerIdFromCaller on createAndPair) OR by Assign_EmployerId_FromTable / Assign_EmployerId_FromLookup on resolveEmployer. Every downstream node reads this instead of the two source paths.
variables.name: var_Match_EmployerAccountId

variables.description: Subflow-local scratch: match amount used by every writer inside createAndPair (Assign_Employer_GT_Fields.OriginalAmount, Assign_Employer_Recurring_GCS.TransactionAmount, Assign_MatchSoftCredit_OnEmployer.PartialAmount, formulaEmployerRecurringCommitmentName). Written by Assign_Init_CreateAndPair from in_matchAmountFromCaller. Never reads numMatchAmount directly on createAndPair (Details_MatchAmount does not render).
variables.name: var_MatchAmount

variables.description: Subflow-local scratch: match GT status. Written by Assign_Init_CreateAndPair from in_matchStatusFromCaller. Values: "Pending" / "Paid". Read by Assign_Employer_GT_Fields.Status.
variables.name: var_MatchStatus

variables.description: Phase F3a. Record variable staged by Assign_ACR_Fields, inserted by Create_MatchACR. AccountContactRelation between donor PersonContact and employer Account.
variables.name: rsv_MatchACR

variables.description: Phase F2. Record variable staged by Assign_Employer_GT_Fields, inserted by Create_Employer_GT. Paired employer-match GiftTransaction.
variables.name: rsv_MatchEmployerGT

variables.description: Phase F3b. Record variable staged by Assign_MatchSoftCredit_OnDonor, inserted by Create_MatchSoftCredit_OnDonor. Corporate-Account recognition on the donor GT (Role = 'Matched Donor').
variables.name: rsv_MatchSoftCredit_OnDonor

variables.description: Phase F3b. Record variable staged by Assign_MatchSoftCredit_OnEmployer, inserted by Create_MatchSoftCredit_OnEmployer. Donor-Person-Account recognition on the employer GT.
variables.name: rsv_MatchSoftCredit_OnEmployer

variables.description: Phase G2. Record variable staged by Assign_Employer_Recurring_GC, inserted by Create_Employer_Recurring_GC. Parallel Recurring GiftCommitment on the employer Account.
variables.name: rsv_EmployerRecurring_GC

variables.description: Phase G2. Record variable staged by Assign_Employer_Recurring_GCS, inserted by Create_Employer_Recurring_GCS. Open-ended GiftCommitmentSchedule row for employer's parallel Recurring GC.
variables.name: rsv_EmployerRecurring_GCS

variables.description: Phase G2. Record variable staged by Assign_Employer_Recurring_GDD, inserted by Create_Employer_Recurring_GDD. GiftDefaultDesignation on the employer's Recurring GC.
variables.name: rsv_EmployerRecurring_GDD

variables.description: G4: Employer Account picked from dtEmployers on Pick_MatchEmployer (firstSelectedRow output). Null when the user relied on the fallback flowruntime:lookup instead. Decide_Employer_Source reads rsv_SelectedEmployer.Id to route between datatable-selection and lookup-selection paths.
variables.name: rsv_SelectedEmployer

variables.description: Phase F2. Shell record variable for Update_Donor_With_Pair. Built by Assign_Pair_Onto_Donor_GT_Shell with just Id + MatchingEmployerTransactionId + FQS_Match_Status__c. Subflow owns the DML — caller passes donor GT Id (in_donorGiftTransactionId scalar) rather than the SObject to sidestep field-drop on cross-flow marshalling per [[flow-sobject-assign-drops-fields]].
variables.name: rsv_UpdateDonorGT
